t: You're at the Fulham Road Jewish Cemetery, a burial ground in the Royal Borough of Kensington and Chelsea. It's easy to miss. A locked door on the Fulham Road is the only entrance, and the cemetery isn't visible from the street. Blocks of flats surround it and look down over it. Among those buried here is Solomon Bennet, an engraver of copperplate who was born in Russia. He lived from 1767 to 1841.
